era_verdict.verdict_string: TEXTURE_ERA_VERDICT: the lab's 'PE2003 CD era' / 'real 2003 textures' claim is REJECTED. All 31 lineage rows trace to the M3-2 texture cache extracted from the EU_LATER-era Textures.bnt (SHA256 2EAE1159...), which PEProvenance.js labels EU_LATER (RE evidence only). The textures are NOT Jan2003 Textures.ark members and NOT PCG9.3.5. Bounded comparison vs the CD_JAN_2003 Textures.ark: 16/24 member payloads byte-identical, 8/24 byte-different - identical IDs or correct-looking images do NOT prove era match.

per_member_comparison_vs_cd_jan_2003.era_status_note: Pixel-identity for the 8 byte-different members was NOT evaluated (would require decoding both payloads; no new decoder / no extraction allowed). Their visual relationship and era relationship are UNKNOWN.
per_member_comparison_vs_cd_jan_2003.m3_3_inconsistency_note: M3-3 02_ark_bnt_cross_reference.json classifies ALL 24 IDs as ARK_ONLY (bnt side null), contradicting the physical presence of the same numeric IDs in the EU_LATER Textures.bnt proven by M3-2/M3-2-R1; M3-3 namespace matching is unreliable for these rows and was used only for ARK-side hashes.

records.era_comparison_vs_cd_jan_2003: 16/24 byte-identical, 8/24 byte-different, 0 absent; per-member era NOT_ESTABLISHED for the 8 byte-different

lookup_rules.era_is_identity: era is part of the resource identity, never a fallback (PEProvenance.js charter: NO silent cross-era substitution)
